message: Last weekend, we had a surprise blackout. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and powered up my phone, but what really kept the mood light was our family group chat. Between the memes and funny stories about our blackout snacks, it felt less like a crisis and more like a mini-adventure. It reminded me how important it is to stay connected and have a plan in place. Have you ever experienced a power outage with your family? What did you do to keep the spirits up?
